title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-optimizations
author: Jordan Kim
release_notes: Enhance unified rollouts: improve canary/A-B/ shadow workflows and autorollback heuristics. Includes observability and e2e tests.
description: Motivation: customer traffic spikes and a recent incident showed that our autorollback engine could be slow to quarantine models when combined canary + shadow traffic patterns produce noisy signals. This PR brings a set of stability and performance improvements to the unified-rollouts stack: 1) refine metric matching and quorum rules so A/B and canary stages aggregate signals consistently; 2) introduce a lightweight probation/quarantine stage before full rollback to reduce false positives during transient noise; 3) improve shadow traffic probing to use sampling and batching to avoid spamming downstream models; 4) add safety guards and adjustable thresholds via rollout policy config; 5) add end-to-end tests and dashboard panels for rollback telemetry. The description below lists the changes and checklist. Changes summary: - rollout/engine: algorithmic improvements to metric aggregation and quorum matching; introduce a "probation" substage with configurable window and minimum samples - rollout/autorollback: faster detection path for threshold breaches, add hysteresis and backoff to avoid oscillation - rollout/traffic-router: sampled shadow probing and backpressure to reduce KV cache churn on slower model variants - observability: new metrics (rollout.probation_events, rollout.quarantine_count, rollout.rollback_latency) and dashboards for per-stage SLI - e2e tests: new deterministic tests for canary + AB + shadow paths that simulate noise and verify no false rollback within allowed hysteresis - docs: rollout policy examples and guidance for tuning thresholds and probe sampling Checklist: - [x] Core logic implemented and unit tested - [x] Integration tests added for quorum/matching behavior - [x] End-to-end tests for canary+A/B+shadow scenarios - [x] Dashboard panels and alerts added - [x] Performance benchmarked on canary workloads - [x] Updated docs and examples Breaking change notes: configuration keys are additive and default to previous behavior (no breaking changes).

merge_commit_message:
squash: unified rollouts canary/AB/shadow autorollback optimizations

- probation substage and window
- fast-path threshold detection with hysteresis
- sampled shadow probing and backpressure
- observability and e2e tests
notes: This PR is part of ENG-1428 which aims to reduce rollback-induced downtime by improving decision stability across combined rollout modes. Monitoring: watch rollout.rollback_latency and rollout.quarantine_count for the first 48h after rollout. If alert noise increases, consider raising probation.window_ms or quorum.minimum_samples.
testing_and_benchmarks: Benchmarks: applied a 10k rps synthetic canary workload with 1% shadow traffic to measure overhead. Result: autorollback decision latency reduced from 12s to 4-6s under typical load; CPU overhead increased ~3% on controller nodes. e2e covers deterministic noise patterns and CI includes a perf job to validate no regressions.
user_facing_changes: New rollout policy knobs: probation.window_ms, probation.minimum_samples, shadow.sample_rate, autorollback.hysteresis_ms. Defaults preserve existing behavior. Docs updated with tuning guidance.
migration_instructions: No migration required. New config keys are optional. For enterprise Dedicated customers, recommend testing policy on a small traffic slice before full rollout.
follow_up_work: Track post-deploy telemetry for 48h; follow-up to add adaptive probation window based on observed noise (ENG-1432). Consider a lightweight ML-based anomaly filter if oscillation persists.
security_notes: No new permissions. Shadow sampling reduces downstream exposure and is opt-in in rollout policy.
